description: This file defines the enum `ChatMarkdownPreprocessor` which provides static methods for preprocessing chat message markdown content, including stripping embeddings, message IDs, inbound context blocks, timestamps, and parsing inline images in markdown. It handles untrusted metadata and context blocks, normalizes markdown content, and extracts inline images encoded as base64 data URLs.

classes.name: ChatMarkdownPreprocessor.Result
classes.description: A struct to hold the cleaned markdown string and associated inline images after preprocessing.

classes.name: ChatMarkdownPreprocessor.InlineImage
classes.description: A struct representing an inline image embedded in the markdown, with a label and optional image data.

methods.name: preprocess
methods.description: Main static method that applies various stripping functions to clean and parse markdown input, including extracting inline images.
